Based on the two links you sent, there is **no objective difference** between the sellers.

I checked both pages and they list the exact same product with the exact same terms:

**Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite

| Feature | Seller A - Brackmoor Sound | Seller B - Ottervale Audio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Stock / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Specs / In the box** | Same - 40h battery, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, case + cables | Same - 40h battery, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, case + cables |

Because the price, shipping time, return policy, warranty, and rating are identical on the pages provided, there is no reason to prefer one over the other based on this listing information alone.

You can buy from either - if you have bought from one of them before or have an account with one, use that one as a tie-breaker.
